voice: Fish Audio clone of Rahul Parathy (private) 77ab7119f4c44e56be9e1bdce74d2fc7

lines.S01: Hi, I'm Rahul, a medical student from Sri Lanka.
lines.S02: For the Lovable and Contra challenge, I built Marlowe and Ash: a small hair colour studio in Sarasota, Florida, with just one chair.
lines.S03: Meet Mara. She's the only colourist in the studio, so she does everything herself.
lines.S04: Before, every booking meant DMs, missed calls, and endless back-and-forth.
lines.S05: And when a client didn't show up, a long colour appointment just left her chair empty.
lines.S06: So I rebuilt the moment 'Can I book with you?' turns into 'You're booked', with Mara barely lifting a finger.
lines.S08: A warm, fast site with her services, prices, reviews and story, on any phone or laptop.
lines.S09: They pick a service, then a time. Every slot shows in Eastern time, and the calendar keeps a buffer around every appointment, so Mara is never double-booked.
lines.S10: Appointments over two hours, bookings less than forty-eight hours away, and clients with a no-show history pay a half deposit through Stripe. Everyone else can simply pay at the salon.
lines.S11: Booked. They get a confirmation email, a calendar invite, and reminders two days and three hours before, with a one-tap 'Yes, I'm coming'.
lines.S12: No time that works? They join the waitlist. Not sure what to book? They tell Mara, with photos. Want to spoil a friend? They send a gift card.
lines.S13: Cancel more than forty-eight hours ahead, and the deposit is refunded automatically. Any later, and it's kept. The no-show rule enforces itself.
lines.S14: Now... let's look at Mara's side.
lines.S15: Every booking, cancellation and refund pings her on Telegram, the moment it happens.
lines.S16: Her dashboard shows today at a glance, who's on the site right now, and one switch to pause new bookings.
lines.S17: If she needs to move an appointment, she picks a new time, and the client is emailed instantly.
lines.S18: When an inquiry comes in, she taps 'Offer a time', and only her free slots on the client's chosen days appear. Pick one, confirm, and it's sent.
lines.S19: When someone cancels, the slot is offered to the waitlist automatically, so the chair fills itself.
lines.S20: Loyal clients collect stamps, and every fifth visit earns a twenty-five dollar reward.
lines.S21: Time off takes seconds, and her stats show exactly how much time the studio saved her this week.
lines.S22: From 'Can I book with you?' to 'You're booked'. No calls. No chasing. No empty chair.
lines.S23: Built entirely with Lovable. Thank you, Lovable and Contra.
lines.C01: In this video, I'll walk you through the client side: everything a customer sees and does.
lines.C02: Mara's story, her reference looks, a wall of reviews, the FAQ, and the studio's address and hours are all right here.
lines.C03: From here, a client can do four things: book a time, join the waitlist, ask Mara, or buy a gift card.
lines.C04: Let's book a wedding trial at eleven a.m. Once it's taken, every overlapping slot disappears, so Mara can never be double-booked.
lines.C05: First-timers tick one box. Returning clients skip it.
lines.C06: The test card is shown right on the page, and gift card or reward codes work at checkout too.
lines.C07: Payment runs through Stripe in test mode, and the booking is guaranteed.
lines.C08: Clients sign in with Google, Microsoft, Apple, or a magic email link, and see every booking, guaranteed or unconfirmed, in one place.
lines.C09: Every completed visit earns a stamp. Five stamps unlock a twenty-five dollar reward.
lines.C10: On the waitlist, they pick a service and the days that work. When a matching slot opens, they're emailed, and it's held for them for thirty minutes.
lines.C11: Buying a gift card takes seconds. The buyer and the recipient both get an email, with the gift code inside.
lines.C12: And with Tell Mara, they describe what they want, add photos, and get an instant suggestion. Or they send it to Mara, and she offers them a real time.
lines.O01: This video is all about Mara, and the studio dashboard that runs the business for her.
lines.O02: She can also see which pages people visit, and where they came from.
lines.O03: Moving an appointment herself never uses up the client's own reschedule.
lines.O04: No free time on those days? One button asks the client for other times, and the whole exchange happens by email, automatically.
lines.O05: From a client's profile, she adds a stamp with a quick note, and the client sees it on their account straight away.
lines.O06: Time off can block a whole day, a date range, or just part of a day.
lines.O07: Her weekly hours are set once. Sundays and Mondays stay closed.
lines.O08: When a client spends part of a gift card at the studio, Mara applies the amount, and the ledger keeps the balance.
lines.O09: Her stats show bookings taken online, reminders sent, refunds and waitlist offers, plus an estimate of the hours all of that saved her.
lines.O10: She can update her prices any time, while the core booking rules stay locked, so nothing breaks by accident.
lines.O11: If a pay-at-salon client never confirms, their slot is released and offered to the waitlist.
